svg.title: Actual and effective force versus time
svg.desc: A graph of force F versus time t. The actual force rises smoothly from zero at t1 to a peak midway between t1 and t2 and falls back to zero at t2. The effective force Feff is constant from t1 to t2 at half the peak value. The area under the actual-force curve equals the area of the Feff rectangle, so both forces deliver the same impulse. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Impulse is the accumulated force–time area
The rectangle and complete pulse have equal total area; their partial areas need not be equal.
